## Services
- Large format porcelain walls: Large format porcelain brings the stunning look of stone to your walls, with fewer seams to interrupt the design. Its lighter weight makes it a great fit for accent walls and full-height entries, creating a focal point for the room.
- Large format porcelain showers: A shower should be easy to enjoy and easy to clean. Large format porcelain lets the pattern run across your walls with fewer interruptions and far fewer grout lines to scrub. You get the look you want, with less upkeep.
- Large format porcelain fireplaces: A fireplace is already a focal point. Large format porcelain gives it the look of stone, with large panels that let the pattern run from hearth to ceiling. Fewer seams keep the attention on the design.
- Large format porcelain floors: Large format porcelain gives you the look of stone underfoot, with fewer grout lines to break up the pattern or spend time cleaning. The large panels create a continuous look across the room, and porcelain never needs sealing.
- Porcelain countertops and vanities: Outdoor kitchens need surfaces that can handle everyday use and the weather. Porcelain is non-porous and UV resistant, making it a great choice for outdoor countertops. It’s easy to clean, never needs sealing and resists fading in the sun.
